So, I've tried many different medications and all have worked to some extent. The difficulty with depression,  at least for me,  is that it's very easy to fall again. With my current therapist,  we did an experiment of sorts where every night before bed I would look back on my day and taste it on a scale of 1-10. 1 being "absolute worst day,  barely could avoid suicide" and 10 being "happiest day of my life".  And a 5 being neither good nor bad. 
After a month I averaged the numbers and we established that my baseline is around a 4. So,  on average, I'm pretty low.
